post.description: Asks one agent through Magnus (a mission at studio level 2 with Ardent 2.2.0, else task-submit) for a TeamProposal JSON reply with the brief, deliverables, templates and available agents. An invalid reply is retried once with the validation error, then the proposal fails. Progress arrives as team.proposal.updated; nothing is applied. 409 NO_COORDINATOR without agent_ref and a bound coordinator, 409 PROPOSAL_IN_PROGRESS while one is queued or running, 422 UNKNOWN_AGENT, 409 AGENT_UNAVAILABLE, 503 MAGNUS_UNAVAILABLE.

Each part is checked against its base revision. Results are per part; skill and model changes report activation_required (a profile restart, which Studio cannot run). Running tasks keep their instructions.

Persisted events carry their seq as the SSE id and replay after ?after=. reset means the cursor is older than retained events (or ahead of them): refetch the snapshot. message.delta (live reply text) has no id; on connect each streaming message gets one replace delta with its current text. heartbeat every 15 s. The stream closes when the token expires or its session ends; reconnect with a fresh token.
